name: @chewygumxx/skill-mapping-tests
description: Keeps each test file under 20 KiB and maps it to a mise task naming the paths it covers, so the tests of any path can be found and run alone. Use when adding, moving, renaming or deleting a test file, or changing what one runs, in a repository whose tests are mapped by mise tasks; when a test file passes 20 KiB or holds several subjects' tests; or when mapping a repository's tests for `mise tasks` and `mise mcp`.
